title: SOX error envelope
description: Standard error response returned by the SOX MCP server when a tool call cannot be completed. This is the server-to-caller error shape; it is not a channel message body (it is never stored in the backing store). Returned inline as the tool call result when the operation fails.

error_code.description: Machine-readable error code. 'identity_failure': caller could not be authenticated or authorised. 'channel_not_found': specified channel does not exist or has no recent activity. 'subscription_not_found': recv called for a channel the agent is not subscribed to. 'validation_error': input does not conform to the operation schema. 'rate_limited': caller has exceeded a rate limit. 'store_unavailable': backing store is unreachable or returned an error. 'version_mismatch': protocol major version of caller and server differ. 'internal_error': unexpected server-side error.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error. MUST NOT leak internal implementation details (stack traces, file paths, credentials).

detail.description: Optional. Structured additional detail. For 'validation_error', this SHOULD contain a list of validation failures. Shape is error_code-specific.

retry_after.description: Optional. Unix epoch seconds after which the caller MAY retry. Populated for 'rate_limited' and transient 'store_unavailable' errors. Null means no retry guidance.

examples.message: Agent identity could not be verified. Ensure SOX_AGENT_SECRET is set correctly.
Input does not conform to send.input.schema.json.
Send rate limit exceeded. Maximum 100 sends per minute per agent.
Backing store is temporarily unreachable. Retry after indicated time.
